 Value-ad partnership
 At FleishmanHillard, we strive on a daily basis to provide effective and value-based communication support in cooperation with our clients and by understanding their business goals. For us, public relations means real and continuously cultivated relationships, which we relish to develop our clients' reputations, whether in external or internal communication.
 As creative and innovative consultants, we have decades of experience in many fields, from the financial market to lifestyle services and the technology sector. The success of our work is proven by numerous domestic and international awards and the multiple winning of the title "PR agency of the year".
 Creativity and Innovation
 Global Network, Local Expertise
 We joined the international network of FleishmanHillard in 2009, joining the work of one of the world's largest communications agencies and the two-way knowledge sharing. We adopted the name FleishmanHillard in 2020, further strengthening our connection with the global network. As part of our collaboration, we serve key clients across Europe.
 The key to effective communication is to effectively address and activate the target audience. However, to do this, we need to know the motivations, considerations, and preferences of our target groups. We use an internationally recognized methodology to dig up these insights and insights. After that, we use all channels and tools capable of reaching and mobilizing target groups, applying a wide variety of communication disciplines in an integrated manner.
